features.name: Necromancy Savant
features.desc: You copy Necromancy spells in half the time and for half the gold.

features.name: Grim Harvest
features.desc: Once per turn, when you kill a creature with a spell, you regain Hit Points (2 × the spell's level, + the level again for Necromancy spells).

features.name: Undead Thralls
features.desc: Animate Dead raises one additional Undead; your Undead servants gain extra Hit Points and extra damage (Proficiency Bonus).

features.name: Inured to Undeath
features.desc: Resistance to Necrotic damage; your Hit Point maximum can't be reduced.

features.name: Command Undead
features.desc: As an action, you take control of an Undead within 60 feet (Charisma saving throw).
